SOFTWARE SUPPORT AGREEMENT

This Software Support Agreement is entered into as of February 2, 2026 between Quillon Software, Inc. ("Vendor") and Hartwell Clinics, P.C. ("Customer").

1. Support. Vendor will help Customer with questions about the scheduling software.

2. Cooperation. Customer will give Vendor remote access to its systems when Vendor asks.

3. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Illinois.
